summary: A hotel booking system with MongoDB persistence and CRUD operations. Requirements will clarify the desired user interface and feature scope.

workspaceSignals.decisionReason: The workspace contains no existing application project files.

questions.question: Which programming language for Hotel Booking Web App?
questions.rationale: TypeScript is a strong default for a maintainable booking web application.

questions.question: Which frontend framework should the Hotel Booking Web App use?
questions.rationale: React + Vite is a broadly supported SPA choice; select or enter the interface stack you prefer.

questions.question: Describe the desired interface and features for the hotel booking system (for example, customer booking flow, hotel/room administration, reservation CRUD, search/filtering, and whether customers, staff, or both will use it).
questions.answer: A customer-facing hotel search and booking interface plus staff/admin screens to create, view, update, and delete hotels, rooms, and reservations. Include availability search and reservation status management.
questions.rationale: The prompt establishes a hotel booking system and CRUD operations, but the intended users, interface, and exact feature scope need confirmation.
questions.recommendedChoice: A customer-facing hotel search and booking interface plus staff/admin screens to create, view, update, and delete hotels, rooms, and reservations. Include availability search and reservation status management.

questions.question: Which programming language for Hotel Booking API?
questions.rationale: TypeScript pairs naturally with a TypeScript web client; choose another supported backend language if preferred.

questions.question: Which framework should the Hotel Booking API use?
questions.rationale: Express is a simple default for CRUD endpoints; framework choice depends on the selected backend language.

questions.question: Describe the API routes or backend behavior needed for Hotel Booking API.
questions.answer: CRUD endpoints for hotels, rooms, and reservations; hotel/room search and availability checks; prevent overlapping reservations; validate dates and capacity; manage reservation status.
questions.rationale: CRUD is requested; the entities and booking rules are proposed defaults for confirmation.
questions.recommendedChoice: CRUD endpoints for hotels, rooms, and reservations; hotel/room search and availability checks; prevent overlapping reservations; validate dates and capacity; manage reservation status.

questions.question: Which data stores does your app need?
questions.rationale: MongoDB is an explicit user requirement and is appropriate for the booking system's persistent data.

options.label: No datastore required
options.description: The app does not persist data or use storage, queues, or caches

options.label: MongoDB
options.description: MongoDB document database, explicitly requested for hotel booking data

questions.question: Does this app need user login?
questions.rationale: Customer bookings and staff administration commonly require accounts, but the prompt does not specify whether sign-in is desired.

options.label: Yes
options.description: Add a user sign-in flow and authenticated API access

options.label: No
options.description: No user sign-in or authenticated API access
